battle.name: 中國
battle.brief: 公元前722年，周宣王遣大將軍韓贄與太師龐喜率王師第三次北伐猃狁，大軍沿黃河以北進抵河套朔方。卡面所列的埃及月牙劍代表青銅時代單刃砍劈形制，西周士卒實際配備的是戈、矛、戟與早期銅劍。此次出師遇大雨泥濘、糧秣不繼，逗留不前而無功而返，朝廷其後改以築城屯戍固守北疆。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 交戰一方是西周王師，另一方是活動於河套、陰山一線的戎狄部族，漢代文獻稱之為猃狁，古籍亦與鬼方、犬戎諸部並列。西周是典型的宗法封建體制，天子居中，諸侯屏藩；王師是國家中樞武力，分為西六師與殷八師共十二師，《周禮·夏官》以萬有二千五百人為一師，是制度上的理想編制，實際出動多寡由天子與大將軍斟酌。此役周宣王以大將軍韓贄為主將、太師龐喜為副將，採中軍、上軍分領之法：韓贄統中軍當前鋒與主攻，龐喜領上軍策應，另有部分兵力留守鎬京、洛邑一線的王畿防務。諸侯方面，晉、秦、杞等方國奉命轉輸軍糧、徵發徒卒、扼守要道，屬附庸式的協作，而非自主作戰。戎狄一方沒有常備軍與固定城郭，以部族為軍事單位，首領按季節集結人馬，作戰時合、掠奪時散，馬隊是核心，行動隨水草遷徙而流動。雙方形態差異是理解此役的關鍵：周軍重裝備、重車陣，作戰重心在正面對峙與攻城；戎狄則以騎射與流動為本，專尋車陣薄弱處施襲。
countriesEn: One side was the royal army of the Western Zhou; the other was the Rong-Di tribal confederation that ranged through the Hetao loop and the Yin Mountains, called Xianyun in Han-dynasty sources and listed alongside the Guifang and Quanrong branches in older texts. The Western Zhou was a typical kinship-and-feudal order with the Son of Heaven at its centre and the lords as shields. The royal army was the state's central military force, divided into the Six Western Divisions and the Eight Yin Divisions, twelve divisions in all; the Zhouli gives a paper strength of 12,500 men to a division, which is an idealised establishment figure, while the real size of any campaign was weighed by the king together with his grand commander. In this campaign King Xuan set General Han Zhi as commander-in-chief and Grand Preceptor Pang Xi as deputy, following the Three Armies pattern: Han Zhi led the central army with the main body of chariots and armoured infantry, Pang Xi led the upper army in support, and part of the troops was held back to guard the royal capital zone around Haojing and Luoyi. The lords of Jin, Qin, Qi and others were ordered to convoy grain, levy footsoldiers and hold the key roads; they offered subordinate co-operation rather than fighting on their own initiative. The Xianyun had neither a standing army nor fixed towns to defend. Military units were tribal, the chiefs mustered their people according to the season, and mounted bands that joined for battle scattered again for plunder. The decisive difference was structural: the Zhou army was equipment-heavy and chariot-centred, built for set-piece field action and siege, while the Rong-Di relied on riding, shooting and mobility, always probing for the weak point in a chariot line.
people: 周宣王姬靜是此役的決策者，在位前827年至前782年共四十六年，以「宣王中興」見稱於世，前期倚重召穆公、尹吉甫、仲山甫、程伯休父、虢文公、韓侯等一批卿士，屢次對外用兵。此役的直接指揮是大將軍韓贄：他在前824年的戰事中已率軍深入戎地，破了猃狁，奪獲馬牛羊，並因此受封韓地，是西周對北作戰經驗最厚的統帥，此次仍由他統中軍。至於太師龐喜，傳世記載說他主張乘勝追擊、力戰求勝，與韓贄的持重主張相左；大軍在北方逗留既久、糧秣又告斷絕，兵敗的責任遂落在龐喜身上，傳聞他因此逃往太原，韓贄則受貶議。此役之後，宣王改採守勢固邊，築朔方城，命秦莊公率秦人西戍，又令韓侯、程伯休父等分守邊邑，試圖以秦、晉之眾力代替王師的遠征。戎狄方面的首領姓名沒有留下可靠記載，只以部族名稱見於傳世文獻，因此這場戰爭的對面決策層幾乎完全被史書的空白掩蓋，只能從王師的部署與失敗的過程反推其行動方式。
peopleEn: King Xuan of Zhou, personal name Jing, was the man who decided this campaign. He reigned from 827 to 782 BC, forty-six years in all, and is remembered for the so-called revival of King Xuan. In the earlier part of his reign he relied on a group of ministers and lords such as Duke Shao of Shao, Yin Jifu, Zhong Shanfu, Cheng Boxiu, Duke Wen of Guo and the Marquis of Han, and he waged war beyond the frontier again and again. The direct command of this campaign belonged to General Han Zhi: as early as 824 BC he had already led troops deep into Rong territory, defeated the Xianyun, seized horses, cattle and sheep, and was enfeoffed at Han for it, making him the Zhou commander with the thickest experience of fighting in the north, and he once again held the central army. As for Grand Preceptor Pang Xi, transmitted accounts say he urged pursuit and pitched battle in order to win, which clashed with Han Zhi's more deliberate line; when the army lay idle in the north for a long stretch and the grain ran out, the blame for the failure fell on Pang Xi, who is said to have fled to Taiyuan, while Han Zhi was downgraded and criticised. After this campaign King Xuan switched to a defensive posture, built the fortified town of Shuofang, ordered Qin Zhuang Gong to lead Qin troops to garrison the west, and stationed the Marquis of Han, Cheng Boxiu and others at the frontier towns, hoping to replace the long marches of the royal army with the manpower of Qin and Jin. No reliable record preserves the names of the Xianyun leaders; they appear only as tribal names in the transmitted texts, so the decision-making on the other side of this war is almost entirely wrapped in the blank spaces of the chronicles and has to be reconstructed from the deployment of the Zhou army and the way its campaign fell apart.
kits: 卡面主兵器是埃及月牙劍（Khopesh）：外彎的單刃青銅短劍，刃身呈勾月形，砍下去不必回拔，適合對付無甲或輕甲目標，是古埃及新王國時期的典型近戰兵器。就本場戰爭而言，月牙劍本身並非西周軍隊的制式裝備，它在卡面上代表的是青銅時代單刃砍劈型兵刃這一譜系；西周士卒真正握在手上的，是商周以來沿用的戈、矛、戟與早期銅劍。那批早期銅劍多作柳葉形，平面無格，長約二十至四十厘米，單刃或對稱雙刃，格與首都尚未成形，功能上最接近月牙劍的，是那些弧刃、厚重、砍下去不必回拔的短兵器。西周車兵的裝備配置大致如下：直內或三援的青銅戈、長柄木矛、戈矛合體的戟；上甲之士著皮甲並綴以青銅甲片，佩青銅獸面面具，下甲徒兵多持木盾或皮盾；弓兵用骨鏃、石鏢與竹木弓；戎車以三匹馬挽曳，兵車用四匹，車上甲士三人分為御者、射手與持戈者，車旁備箭囊與長矛。馬具已用青銅馬軛與銅泡飾件，運輸靠牛車負糧。戎狄方面全無車陣，以馬自備糧秣，皮毛為甲，革弓短箭，配弧刃短刀與木矛，行動速度是唯一的戰略優勢。野戰無攻城器械，塹壕與木柵是唯一可用的工事。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card face is the Egyptian khopesh: a single-edged bronze short sword with an outward-curving blade, crescent in outline, which cuts downward without having to be pulled back, and which suits unarmoured or lightly armoured targets; it is the typical close-combat arm of the New Kingdom period in ancient Egypt. For this particular war, the khopesh was not part of the Zhou establishment. What it stands for on the card is the family of single-edged chopping weapons of the Bronze Age: the things actually in the hands of Zhou soldiers were the ge dagger-axe, the mao spear, the ji halberd and early bronze swords that had been in use since the Shang. Those early bronze swords are mostly willow-leaf shaped, flat, without a guard, about twenty to forty centimetres long, single-edged or symmetrically double-edged, with neither guard nor pommel yet developed; the closest functional relatives of the khopesh are the heavy, curved-edged short weapons that bite into a target and need no draw-back. The equipment of a Zhou chariot troop ran roughly as follows: bronze ge with a straight tang or three blades, wooden-shafted spears, and ji formed by combining ge and spear; men of the upper rank wore hide armour reinforced with bronze plates and bronze animal-mask helmets, while lower-rank footsoldiers carried wooden or hide shields; archers used bone or stone arrowheads and bamboo-and-wood bows; war chariots were drawn by three horses and plain chariots by four, and each chariot carried three armoured men, a driver, an archer and a spear bearer, with quivers and long spears stowed at the side. The harness already used bronze yokes and bronze-stud fittings, and ox carts carried the grain. The Rong-Di had no chariot line at all, carried their provisions on horseback, wore hide and wool for armour, used composite bows with short arrows, and equipped themselves with curved short knives and wooden spears; for them mobility was the only strategic advantage. There were no siege engines in the field, and a ditch or a wooden stockade was the only field fortification available.
tactics: 周軍依三軍之制布陣：中軍由大將軍韓贄居中，統主力車隊與甲士；上軍由太師龐喜領兵策應；下軍與兩翼分擔迂迴與警戒。野戰的基本次序是先偵察、再爭隘口、最後縱車衝擊：前列由徒兵與盾兵據險固守，弓兵側射壓制，戎車居中突破，車兵兩翼張開以護住車陣兩側，甲士在車闌掩護下與步卒交替進逼，一退一進，把推進速度壓在步行可承受的範圍內。若對方避戰不來，就採環車為營、三面布甲、輪番警戒的守禦法，坐等敵騎先動。戎狄的戰術恰好相反：不與車陣硬撞，以輕騎繞射側後，切斷車隊與糧隊之間的聯繫，誘使追擊，再把追兵引入狹窄谷口、河道與沼澤地帶，靠地形與天候截斷退路。糧秣線由洛邑、鎬京方向經河內渡河輸送，車隊一日行程有限，雨季道路泥濘時車輪下陷、馬匹疲敝，前鋒與後隊一旦脫節便再也拉不開。此役正是在雨季中行軍，隊伍遲滯於北地，糧車未能按期抵達，士卒久宿於外，進退失據，最終只能收兵退回。
tacticsEn: The Zhou army deployed according to the Three Armies system: the central army, commanded by General Han Zhi, held the main body of chariots and armoured infantry; the upper army under Grand Preceptor Pang Xi provided support; the lower army and the two flanks took charge of turning movements and covering the flanks. The usual order of a field action was reconnoitre first, then seize the defile, and only at the last moment send the chariots in: the leading line of footsoldiers and shield-bearers held the ground, archers shot from the flank to keep heads down, war chariots broke through in the centre, the chariot troops opened out on both sides to shield the flanks of the line, and the armoured men advanced in relay with the foot behind the chariot rails, pressing forward at a pace a walking army could sustain. If the enemy declined to come to close quarters, the alternative was to form a ring of chariots camped three sides deep in armour and stand in relief, waiting for the enemy horse to move first. The Rong-Di tactics were the exact opposite: they would not strike a chariot line head on, but sent light horse round the flanks and rear to shoot, cut the link between the chariots and the grain convoy, and lure a pursuit before drawing the pursuers into narrow gorges, river channels and marsh country, using terrain and weather to seal the retreat. The grain line ran from Luoyi and Haojing north across the Yellow River via the Henei crossing. A chariot convoy could only cover so much ground in a day, and in the rainy season the wheels sank and the horses laboured; once the vanguard and the rear fell out of touch they could never be closed up again. This campaign was fought in the rains. The columns stalled in the north, the grain wagons did not arrive on time, the soldiers lay for a long time outside the walls with nothing to show for it, the line could neither advance nor withdraw, and in the end the army had to be recalled.
data: 可以確定的數字不多，謹列有據可考者。此役發生於公元前722年，即周宣王在位第五年；宣王在位共四十六年，紀年為前827年至前782年。就時間序而言，這是西周對猃狁的第三次大規模出兵，前兩次分別在周厲王末年與宣王初年，第三次才由韓贄、龐喜率大軍深入。按《周禮·夏官》記載，萬有二千五百人為一師，王師合西六師、殷八師共十二師，制度上限逾十五萬人，這是理想編制的推算，不能當作此役的實到兵力；文獻沒有留下本役出動人數、斬獲與損耗的可靠數字，傳聞的勝負之數多屬後世鋪陳。距離方面，從鎬京、洛邑到河套朔方，按今地推算在七百公里以上，車隊行軍需數月才能抵達前線。兵器尺寸有實物支撐：西周早期銅劍多長二十至四十厘米，戈援常在二十厘米上下；埃及月牙劍的通行長度約五十至六十厘米，刃長四十厘米上下，重量多在數百克至一公斤之間，屬重量級的單刃砍劈兵器。編制方面，戰車一乘配甲士三人，兵車四馬、戎車三馬。此外，前824年破猃狁之役留有「獲馬牛羊百千匹」一類記載，數目明顯有誇飾，只能視為象徵性收獲，不宜作定量依據。
dataEn: Few figures can be stated with confidence, so only the supportable ones are set down here. The campaign took place in 722 BC, the fifth year of the reign of King Xuan of Zhou; that king ruled for forty-six years, dated from 827 to 782 BC. In chronological terms this was the third large Zhou offensive against the Xianyun, the first two falling in the last years of King Li and early in the reign of King Xuan, and only the third sent a main force deep into the north under Han Zhi and Pang Xi. According to the Zhouli, Xiaoguan, a division numbers 12,500 men, and the royal army comprised the Six Western Divisions and the Eight Yin Divisions, twelve in all, an establishment ceiling of more than 150,000 men; this is an arithmetical ideal and cannot be treated as the actual force fielded. The records leave no reliable figures for the men committed, the captures or the losses of this campaign, and the numbers that float around in later narrative are mostly embellishment. As for distance, the march from Haojing and Luoyi to Shuofang on the Hetao loop is over seven hundred kilometres by modern reckoning, and a chariot convoy needed months of marching to reach the forward areas. The dimensions of the weapons can be supported by excavated examples: early Zhou bronze swords are generally twenty to forty centimetres long, and the blade of a ge usually measures about twenty centimetres; the khopesh of Egypt runs about fifty to sixty centimetres overall with a blade around forty centimetres and a weight of several hundred grams to a little over a kilogram, making it a heavy chopping arm. In establishment terms a chariot carried three armoured men, plain chariots used four horses and war chariots three. One further note: the record of the 824 BC victory that speaks of capturing a hundred thousand horses, cattle and sheep is plainly exaggerated and is better read as symbolic booty than as a quantitative claim.
cause: 打起上來的直接原因是邊境壓力。猃狁各部隨水草遷徙，把河套、陰山一帶的草場與水源當作活動範圍，與周在邊邑的農田、牧場和驛傳道路直接衝突；前824年一役雖破了猃狁，邊患並未因此消除，隔數年之後戎狄重新聚合，逼近王畿北緣。周宣王一朝的國策本來就是以外戰振聲威：他任用召穆公、尹吉甫、南仲等西征西戎、平定淮夷，前824年又命虢文公與韓贄北擊，志在「四境既平，王國庶定」。可另一面，前797年攻太原戎不成、前792年征條戎與奔戎又敗，國力已顯疲態，邊防工事與糧秣儲備都未及整備。於是在內外交困之下，天子仍以一次深入遠征維持聲威，這就是本役的起因：以為兵多勢眾便可一舉殲敵，卻忽略了季節、距離與糧道這些真正決定勝負的因素。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the fighting was pressure on the frontier. The Xianyun clans moved with their herds and treated the grazing lands and water of the Hetao loop and the Yin Mountains as their range, which collided directly with the fields, pastures and courier roads of the Zhou border settlements. The 824 BC victory broke the Xianyun, but the frontier trouble did not end with it; within a few years the Rong-Di gathered again and pressed in on the northern edge of the royal zone. The policy of King Xuan's reign was in any case to build authority through war beyond the frontier: he employed Duke Shao of Shao, Yin Jifu and Nan Zhong to campaign west against the Rong and to pacify the Huaiyi, and in 824 BC he sent Duke Wen of Guo and Han Zhi north, aiming at the formula that with the four quarters settled the royal house would be at peace. Against that, the attack on the Rong of Taiyuan in 797 BC had failed, the campaign against the Tiao and Ben Rong in 792 BC had failed in turn, the state's strength was visibly tired, and neither the frontier works nor the grain reserves had been put in order. So under pressure from within and without, the king still launched one deep offensive to keep up appearances. That is the origin of this campaign: the assumption that sheer numbers would settle the matter in one stroke, while the things that actually decide such a war, the season, the distance and the grain road, went unheeded.
impact: 這一役的直接後果是戰術與國策的轉向。無功而返之後，宣王不再採取主動出擊，而是築城防守：公元前720年前後建成朔方城，位置在今內蒙古鄂托克旗一帶，並派秦莊公率秦人西戍，令韓侯、程伯休父等分守邊邑，把秦、晉推到西北邊防的第一線，為此後秦人長期經營關中與河套、以及漢代在朔方置郡屯田埋下制度上的伏線。國力方面，遠征折騰加上連年用兵，使「宣王中興」的面紗越來越薄；前789年千畝之戰南國全軍覆沒，前771年犬戎攻破鎬京，西周覆亡，與此役之後的財政枯竭、軍心渙散是連在一起的。軍事學上的教訓同樣被記下來：車兵為主的遠征軍最脆弱的環節不是戰場，而是糧道與行軍季節；一旦在雨季深入邊地，再多的甲士與戰車也無法分擔斷糧的風險。此役之後，北方邊防由「出擊」改為「築城屯戍」，後來秦、漢的邊疆經營也沿着以工程取代冒險的方向展開。
impactEn: The direct consequence of this campaign was a change of tack in both tactics and policy. After the fruitless return, King Xuan no longer chose to attack but to fortify: around 720 BC the fortified town of Shuofang was raised in what is now Otog Banner in Inner Mongolia, Qin Zhuang Gong was sent west with Qin troops to garrison the frontier, and the Marquis of Han, Cheng Boxiu and others were ordered to hold the border settlements, pushing Qin and Jin onto the first line of the north-western defence and planting the institutional seed of later Qin management of Guanzhong and the Hetao region and of the Han commanderies and garrisons in Shuofang. On the question of state strength, the wear of a long march added to years of war made the legend of the revival of King Xuan progressively thinner; the destruction of the southern army at the battle of Qianmu in 789 BC and the sacking of Haojing by the Quanrong in 771 BC, which ended the Western Zhou, belong to the same chain of exhausted finances and collapsing morale that began with failures like this one. The military lesson was recorded too: for an expeditionary army built around chariots, the vulnerable link is not the battlefield but the grain road and the marching season. Once a force pushes deep into the frontier during the rains, no amount of armoured men and chariots can spread the risk of a broken supply line. After this campaign the northern frontier shifted from striking out to building walls and garrisoning them, and the later frontier policies of Qin and Han developed along that line of using works of engineering in place of risks of adventure.
result: 這一仗沒有勝負可分。王師深入河套之後，因大雨泥濘、糧秣不繼而逗留不前，既沒有與戎狄主力打成正面交鋒，也沒有攻下任何城邑，最後收兵退回，士氣與補給雙雙受挫；傳統說法是副將龐喜主張追擊而失手，兵敗後逃往太原，統帥韓贄反而受貶議，這說明朝廷把責任推給個人，卻沒有改變用兵的方式。戎狄各部並未被擊潰，仍在河套與陰山一線保持壓力，周朝轉而以朔方城與屯戍軍接替戰車遠征，邊境衝突由「王師討戎」變成「諸侯守邊」的長期消耗。以兵器看，這一場戰爭也留下一個耐人尋味的對照：卡面所列的埃及月牙劍那種厚重單刃弧刃，砍下去不必回拔，在對付皮甲、軟甲與散兵游騎時確實省力；西周那批柳葉形早期銅劍既無格，份量也遠不足以正面砍殺，效率不如戈、矛這類長柄兵器。這場戰役的失敗，恰好說明青銅時代的近戰兵器體系仍要靠戈、矛與車陣才能撐住戰線。
resultEn: This battle had no clean result. After pushing deep into the Hetao loop, the royal army stalled because of the rain, the mud and the broken grain, fought no set-piece action against the main body of the Rong-Di, took no town, and finally withdrew with both its supply and its morale broken. The traditional account has the deputy Pang Xi pushing for a pursuit, missing his stroke, fleeing to Taiyuan after the reverse, with the commander Han Zhi instead blamed and downgraded; that shows the court settling responsibility on individuals while changing nothing about the way it fought. The Rong-Di clans were not broken either and kept up the pressure along the Hetao and the Yin Mountains, so the Zhou substituted the walls of Shuofang and garrison troops for the chariot expeditions, and the border conflict settled into a long attrition of lords holding frontiers rather than kings campaigning against the Rong. Considered through the weapons, the war also leaves an instructive contrast. The Egyptian khopesh on the card, a heavy single-edged blade curved outward that bites without a draw-back, is genuinely efficient against hide armour, soft armour and scattered riders. The early Zhou willow-leaf bronze swords had neither a guard nor the mass to chop in a frontal fight, and were far less efficient than the long-handled ge and mao. The failure of this campaign makes the point precisely: the close-combat arm of the Bronze Age still needed the ge, the spear and the chariot line to hold a front.
